dedupe_keys.name: urbanev open benchmark dataset of urban electric vehicle charging demand shenzhen

description: UrbanEV is an open dataset of electric vehicle charging activity in Shenzhen, China, intended as a benchmark for charging demand prediction. It records charging occupancy, duration, volume and price at 1,682 public charging stations with 24,798 charging piles, collected at five-minute intervals and aggregated to hourly values from 1 September 2022 to 28 February 2023; after cleaning, 1,362 stations and 17,532 piles are grouped into 275 traffic zones of the Shenzhen travel survey, with an adjacency matrix, weather data and spatial proximity features. Benchmarks of statistical, deep learning and transformer models come with it. It was built by researchers of Sun Yat-sen University and Hong Kong Polytechnic University and described in Scientific Data (12:523, 2025). Coverage is city scale, by station and traffic zone. The data are free on Dryad under CC0 (about 320 MB, version 23 of 4 February 2026), with code on GitHub under CC0. Caveats: occupancy is derived from pile status, and only six months are covered. UrbanEV supports capacity planning and siting of charging infrastructure, network flow studies of electric road traffic and grid load forecasting, and relates to the Swedish synthetic charging demand data catalogued here.
